ideas.pitch: A forecasting dashboard built on Poisson GAM and multinomial share models to predict campus infrastructure failures and resource bottlenecks based on historical maintenance logs.
ideas.title: KPRIET Campus AI Safety Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of the Apart Research AI Forecasting hackathon winner by applying robust statistical forecasting and calibrated prediction intervals to a localized domain.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering and risk detection platform tailored for collegiate financial transactions and student club treasuries using Focal LightGBM and graph intelligence.
ideas.title: GraphGuard AML for Student Cooperatives
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the advanced architecture of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner, demonstrating production-ready financial compliance and risk scoring.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered meal recommendation and dietary tracking platform optimized for university mess menus, delivering personalized nutritional insights for student athletes and hostel residents.
ideas.title: Mess-Mate AI Nutrition Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Modeled after the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon winner, this directly solves a hyper-relevant daily problem for every student at KPRIET.

ideas.pitch: Satellite-powered remote sensing and compliance monitoring platform to track green cover changes, construction progress, and land utilization across the KPRIET campus.
ideas.title: GeoNex KPRIET GreenCampus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the runner-up architecture from the Xcelerate Hackathon, bringing high-impact satellite data intelligence to an institutional campus setting.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence and transcription platform that transforms unstructured lecture recordings and seminar videos into fully searchable, accessible multimedia documents.
ideas.title: CampusLibrAI Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning strategy of the Data & Design Hackathon by turning unstructured educational media into a high-utility, searchable knowledge base.
